title: No slippage protection when interacting with AMM
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  - It was noticed that the `amount0Min` & `amount1Min` are set to zero during interactions with the AMM router (Uniswap) for swaps and liquidity additions.
